spec_match.rationale: Uses smoothedRtt, minRtt, rttVariation, estimatedSendRate (null handled as 'hold'), atSendCapacity and datagram counters exactly as the spec defines them.

interactive.rationale: Interval, load and RTT-threshold selects change live behaviour; start/stop restores controls; sparkline and 8-sample history update per sample.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index card describes exactly what the page does.

edge_cases.rationale: Null and absent estimate, session end and rejection are handled; the RTT step-down could not be triggered on localhost (sub-ms RTT) so that branch is verified by code reading only.

references.rationale: Links ChromeStatus, spec estimatedSendRate section and the Microsoft Edge sample.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 headless via Playwright at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch, with --enable-experimental-web-platform-features against a real local Deno 2.9.8 QUIC/HTTP3 echo server (serverCertificateHashes), against the unreachable default public echo server, and without the flag. 9-10 real samples at 500 ms with 200x1000 B load; estimatedSendRate several Gbit/s on loopback so 1080p chosen; stop closed the session and re-enabled Start.

telemetry_health.rationale: First-sample, sample-failure, no-session and surface-missing assertions.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only via kit.css; buttons pair background and color; status colours use emerald-dark and rose.

accessibility.rationale: Sparkline is aria-hidden with a text summary; tier is a polite live region updated only on change; history table in a named scroll region.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Driven at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch: 0px horizontal overflow, single-column stages, 44px buttons/inputs; deno task responsive-check ok on both classes.

openQuestions.title: Exercise the latency step-down on a real WAN path
openQuestions.detail: Loopback RTT is sub-millisecond; verify the step-down and null-estimate hold over a lossy/high-RTT link.

guidanceConsulted.query: status updates live region announce async result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce asynchronous results through polite live regions; keep controls native with visible labels.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every result <output> is aria-live=polite; all inputs/selects have <label for>; buttons use visible text; focus-visible outlines from kit.css.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table without horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap tables in a focusable role=region with an accessible name (aria-labelledby the caption) and let the wrapper scroll instead of the page.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All tables sit in .table-wrap with tabindex=0, role=region and aria-labelledby=<caption id>; 0px page overflow measured at 360x740.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible form inputs labels validation for URL and number fields
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use type=url / inputmode hints, associate labels, and report validation errors with aria-invalid plus a described-by message after interaction.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Certificate-hash field validates on change, sets aria-invalid and fills an aria-describedby error line; numeric fields use inputmode.

guidanceConsulted.query: live updating statistics dashboard aria-live polling without INP regressions
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Pause high-frequency polling when the content is not being shown.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The monitor skips getStats() sampling while document.hidden and announces pause/resume; tier changes (not every sample) are the only live-region updates.

summary: A practical ABR loop driven only by real stats, honest about null estimates; verified with real samples on loopback.
